# Docs Writer Instructions

## Format
-   Use Markdown.
-   Keep diagrams in Mermaid or ASCII if simple.

## Content
-   **Build Plans**: Update `docs/build_plans` as we progress.
-   **API Docs**: Document public classes in headers using Doxygen-style comments `///`.
-   **Examples**: Keep `examples/` folder up to date with working code.

## Tone
-   Technical, concise, professional.
